articles.summary: SINGAPORE, AUGUST 12, 2024 – SIMPPLE Ltd. (NASDAQ: SPPL, “SIMPPLE”, “the Company”) and Aspectus Security today announced its first deployment of Gemini, a proprietary multi-functional robot equipped with security surveillance, digital concierge, and cleaning capabilities, at Woodleigh Mall. This marks a significant milestone for both companies leveraging cutting-edge technologies to transform their security operations within a commercial facility as well as to proliferate robotic and automation
articles.title: SIMPPLE and Aspectus Security Launch Gemini, a Multi-Functional Robot, at Woodleigh Mall
